notes: Sourced from Shure's official PSM1000 online user guide (pubs.shure.com/view/guide/PSM1000/en-US.pdf, version 11, 2020-F) — content verified via a byte-identical mirrored copy at avc-group.com since the pubs.shure.com PDF itself returned 403/unparsable to automated fetch. The P10T is a full-rack (1U, 44 x 483 x 343 mm), dual-channel wireless IEM transmitter. Audio In (L/R) and Loop Out (L/R) are a stereo pair corresponding to the unit's two independent RF channels (Stereo/MX audio mode "transmits each input as a separate channel"). No connector on this device carries a documented bandwidth/version grade: Ethernet speed (10/100/1000) is not stated in Shure's documentation, so grade was omitted per instructions rather than guessed. Antenna BNC ports are RF transmit connections, not signal-graded. The device type enum has no dedicated "wireless in-ear monitor" category; "Wireless mic" was chosen as the closest match (same RF wireless-audio product family) even though the P10T sends a monitor mix to a bodypack rather than transmitting a microphone signal — flagging this as a low-confidence field even though port data itself is high-confidence. Model variants (frequency bands G10/H22/J8/J8A/L8, etc.) differ only in RF range/output power, not in physical I/O.

ports.name: Audio Input L
ports.note: Combo XLR/TRS jack, balanced or unbalanced. Use either jack alone for mono input.

ports.name: Audio Input R
ports.note: Combo XLR/TRS jack, balanced or unbalanced.

ports.name: Loop Out L
ports.note: Sends a copy of the audio signal going into the transmitter to another device; unaffected by input level/pad.

ports.name: Loop Out R
ports.note: Sends a copy of the audio signal going into the transmitter to another device; unaffected by input level/pad.

ports.name: Ethernet 1
ports.note: Part of a two-port RJ-45 jack for network/computer connection and daisy-chaining transmitters. Speed not specified by Shure.

ports.name: Ethernet 2
ports.note: Part of a two-port RJ-45 jack for network/computer connection and daisy-chaining transmitters. Speed not specified by Shure.

ports.name: Headphone Monitor
ports.note: Front-panel 3.5 mm headphone jack for local monitoring; monitor control adjusts level, button toggles between the two transmitter channels.

ports.name: Power In
ports.note: AC mains power input, IEC connector, 100-240 Vac.

ports.name: AC Power Passthrough
ports.note: Unswitched IEC power passthrough used with an IEC extension cable to power another device (internal power-chaining).
